parsed_profile.title: F.05 & HA COMPRESSOR-SECTION RETENTION-KEY IMPROVEMENTS
parsed_profile.purpose: To inform affected users about: 1. The potential for keys retaining sub-assemblies such as stator vane segments, inducer, high pressure packing seal, aft-inducer seal, and/or casing treatment ring to overcome staked retention, which can result in object drops during casing lifts. 2. The availability of an improved key retention method, and the recommendation to install the improved key retention modification during a planned major inspection.
parsed_profile.compliance_category_text: Safety - Failure to comply with this TIL could result in personal injury. Compliance is mandated within a specific operating time.
scope_of_work: Machine threaded holes and counterbores on the UH compressor-section casings at the HJ to accept retention screws.
Install new keys to retain stator-vanes, HPPS, AIS, inducer, and CT ring; torque retention screws to specification.
Stake around the keys at 4x places to serve as secondary retention.
service_recommendation_line_items: Apply the newly configured retention key modification at the next major inspection (MI) when all compressor section upper-half casings will be removed.
The modification may optionally be applied at an earlier opportunity if all affected compressor section UH casings are removed prior to an MI.

Prior to lifting any UH casing, take additional precautions and, if possible, inspect the retention keys for any potential abnormalities such as a displaced key using telescoping mirrors once the UH casing is separated.
Contact regional GE Vernova representative to determine the specific components recommended to be modified on your gas turbine model.
parsed_profile.completion_criteria_text: The TIL is considered as complete once the newly configured key retention modification is installed.
parsed_profile.maintenance_trigger_text: Next scheduled major inspection when all compressor section upper-half casings will be removed.
recommended_interval_or_trigger: Next major inspection (MI) when all compressor section UH casings are removed
Optionally at an earlier opportunity if all affected compressor section UH casings are removed prior to an MI
parsed_profile.hardware_or_part_configuration_text: AIS is installed only on HA.0x units. Inducer is installed only on HA.0x units with a double-wall compressor discharge casing. CT ring is installed only on 7HA.03 units.
parsed_profile.exclusions_or_non_applicable_conditions_: AIS, inducer, and CT ring are installed only on specific gas turbine models; contact GE Vernova representative to determine specific components recommended for modification on your model.
parsed_profile.prerequisite_outage_or_inspection_contex: Requires removal of all compressor section upper-half casings; typically performed during a major inspection.
parsed_profile.sbom_trigger_reason: Modification requires configuration-specific determination of which components (AIS, inducer, CT ring) are installed based on gas turbine model and casing configuration (e.g., double-wall compressor discharge casing on HA.0x units).

parts_referenced.source_location: Scope of Work and Recommendations sections

parts_referenced.source_location: Scope of Work item 2 and Recommendations section

configuration_variables: Presence of inducer (HA.0x units with double-wall compressor discharge casing only)
Presence of CT ring (7HA.03 units only)
parsed_profile.configuration_summary: The specific components requiring the retention key modification vary by gas turbine model. AIS applies only to HA.0x units, inducer applies only to HA.0x units with double-wall compressor discharge casing, and CT ring applies only to 7HA.03 units. Stator vane and HPPS keys apply to all listed models.
severity_signals: Failure to comply with this TIL could result in personal injury
Potential for keys and sub-assemblies to drop during UH casing lifts, which can lead to personnel injury
failure_consequences: Keys and sub-assemblies (stator vane segments, inducer, seals) can drop during upper-half casing lifts
parsed_profile.risk_summary: If retention stakes are not adequately applied, retention keys and sub-assemblies such as stator vane segments, inducer, and seals can fall out during upper-half casing lifts, posing a personnel injury risk. Two prior incidents were reported where keys fell out due to inadequate staking; no injuries occurred in those cases but the hazard remains.

source_snippets.snippet: If the retention stakes are not adequately applied, there is potential for keys and the sub-assemblies, such as stator vane segments, inducer, and seals to drop during UH casing lifts, which can lead to personnel injury.
Machine threaded holes and counterbores on the UH compressor-section casings at the HJ to accept retention screws.
The TIL is considered as complete once the newly configured key retention modification is installed.

It is recommended that the newly configured retention key modification be applied to the unit at the next major inspection (MI) when all the compressor section upper-half (UH) casings will be removed.
AIS is installed only on HA.0x units. Inducer is installed only on HA.Ox units with a double-wall compressor discharge casing. CT ring is installed only on 7HA.03 units.

Prior to lifting any UH casing, GE Vernova recommends the site personnel to take additional precautions and, if possible, to inspect the retention keys for any potential abnormalities such as a displaced key.
